title: chore(deps): bump recharts from 3.9.2 to 3.10.1
body:
Bumps [recharts](https://github.com/recharts/recharts) from 3.9.2 to 3.10.1.
Release notes

Sourced from recharts's releases.

v3.10.1

What's Changed

  • fix(Pie): pass computed innerRadius/outerRadius to Label children via PolarLabelContextProvider by @​0007aadil in recharts/recharts#7458
  • chore(deps): bump immer from 11.1.9 to 11.1.15 by @​dependabot[bot] in recharts/recharts#7575
  • fix(tooltip): fall back to index-based search when label-based search returns undefined for allowDuplicatedCategory=false by @​hxy-asdw in recharts/recharts#7573
  • fix(bar): keep barGap correct when maxBarSize clamps the bar width (#2774) by @​sobol-sudo in recharts/recharts#7582

New Contributors

  • @​0007aadil made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7458
  • @​hxy-asdw made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7573
  • @​sobol-sudo made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7582

Full Changelog: https://github.com/recharts/recharts/compare/v3.10.0...v3.10.1

v3.10.0

What's Changed

Legend position

Legend now supports position and offset props, same as Label and LabeList. This replaces the previous align and verticalAlign for a more convenient positioning, and fixes couple visual bugs too. See https://recharts.github.io/en-US/examples/LegendPosition/

  • Legend position and offset by @​PavelVanecek in recharts/recharts#7564

XAxis auto height

XAxis now supports height="auto" prop, similar to YAxis width="auto".

  • feat(XAxis): support height="auto" to size the axis to its tick labels by @​kimlj in recharts/recharts#7570

Other features

  • feat(Sankey): support accessibilityLayer, title and desc props by @​MahinAnowar in recharts/recharts#7546

Bugfixes

  • fix: clear stale active bar layer state by @​pupuking723 in recharts/recharts#7547
  • fix(Brush): slide snaps back to original position on mouseup when start/endIndex are controlled by @​MaksZhukov in recharts/recharts#7542
  • fix(Tooltip): find the active sector in the angle-axis wrap-around gap by @​MahinAnowar in recharts/recharts#7550
  • fix(Brush): keep controlled startIndex/endIndex on data updates by @​momomuchu in recharts/recharts#7530
  • Fix Legend type by @​PavelVanecek in recharts/recharts#7560
  • fix(Label): pass computed position attributes to custom label content by @​MahinAnowar in recharts/recharts#7549
  • fix(CartesianAxis): skip renderedTicks dispatch when tick values are unchanged by @​kimlj in recharts/recharts#7565
  • fix: prevent getBandSizeOfAxis from collapsing band size due to floating-point tick gaps by @​xianjianlf2 in recharts/recharts#7556
  • fix(Area): connectNulls connects across stacked points where every series is null by @​kimlj in recharts/recharts#7566

New Contributors

  • @​MahinAnowar made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7546
  • @​MaksZhukov made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7542
  • @​momomuchu made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7530
  • @​kimlj made their first contribution in recharts/recharts#7565
